/api/1/origin/https://github.com/lostlight530/welcome-to-github/visit/latest/ – Software Heritage archive 

Get information about the latest visit of a software origin.

#### Request

```
GET https://archive.softwareheritage.org/api/1/origin/https://github.com/lostlight530/welcome-to-github/visit/latest/
```

##### Body

```
{
    "date": "2026-10-24T15:41:45.044000+00:00",
    "metadata": {},
    "origin": "https://github.com/lostlight530/welcome-to-github",
    "origin_url": "https://archive.softwareheritage.org/api/1/origin/https://github.com/lostlight530/welcome-to-github/get/",
    "snapshot": "371992368a1988590993dcb2195a1c7397a33290",
    "snapshot_url": "https://archive.softwareheritage.org/api/1/snapshot/371992368a1988590993dcb2195a1c7397a33290/",
    "status": "full",
    "type": "git",
    "visit": 4
}
```

| URL | Allowed Methods |
| --- | --- |
| https://archive.softwareheritage.org/api/1/origin/ (origin_url) /visit/latest/ | GET, HEAD, OPTIONS |

#### Arguments

origin_url (str)
: a software origin URL

#### Query parameters

require_snapshot (boolean)
: if true, only return a visit with a snapshot

visit_type (str)
: if provided, filter visits by type

#### Request headers

Accept
: the requested response content type, either application/json (default) or application/yaml

#### Response headers

Content-Type
: this depends on Accept header of request

#### Returns

object
: an object containing the following keys:

> - date (string): ISO8601/RFC3339 representation of the visit date (in UTC)
> - origin (str): the origin canonical url
> - origin_url (string): link to get information about the origin
> - snapshot (string): the snapshot identifier of the visit (may be null if status is not full).
> - snapshot_url (string): link to /api/1/snapshot/ in order to get information about the snapshot of the visit (may be null if status is not full).
> - status (string): status of the visit (either full, partial or ongoing)
> - type (string): visit type for the o
